Name: Valley Riverland Map
Author: rivanne
Description:
This map replaces the Riverland/Fishing map.

Version 1 features more land, some simple fancy bridges and tillable grass.
Version 2 features a large cliff separating the lower half of the map.

[b]UPDATE 5/13/17: [/b]I uploaded the correct fixed versions of the map now, so please redownload. It's a tiny fix so you won't get stuck when you're riding your horse from the cindersap forest path.

[u][b]INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:[/b][/u]
- Go to your Content\Maps folder in your stardew valley file directory
- Backup the original fishing map .xnb file by renaming it or moving it into a different folder
- Extract the downloaded file and place farm_fishing.xnb in your Content\Maps folder
- And that’s it! Enjoy!

[b][u]CREDITS:
[/u][/b]I'm using Eemie's Map Recolor in the screenshots, you can find it [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/599/?]here[/url]
